lh4_lad.text: Just back from a run. Mum says I look like a drowned otter. Probably the correct look.
Yr Wyddfa, the name Snowdon goes by in Welsh, means something like the burial mound. It is friendlier than it sounds.
On the long route to the summit I always see a kidgruff on the crags. Grumpy little goat. We get on fine.
